key_policy: Exact canonical little-endian float32 bytes for the remaining 37 inputs, ignoring labels and normalizing signed zero. Disk-backed index; no all-feature matrix in RAM.
membership_rule: Retain a validation row exactly when its 37-feature key is absent from training. This is equivalent to excluding the union of overlaps under the nested masks [], [Number], and [Number, Tot sum]. The same retained indices are used by every arm. Labels are counted only after membership is fixed.
multiplicity_rule: Keep within-validation duplicate multiplicity and all training rows unchanged. No new partition, source deduplication or class-based removal.
replay_rule: Rebuild independently into a fresh directory; require identical completed receipt and both row-index file hashes before publication. Databases and indices remain outside Git.
stopping_rule: Stop on provenance mismatch or inconsistent counts. If any validation class disappears, report the finding but do not authorize a runner. No real-data model scoring, training, test access, cloud launch or automatic promotion. Review panel counts before a CUDA pilot.
